verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs say its Files view lets you explore the app's files and edit its code inside the builder. They also mention a Review view for code diffs, collaborators simultaneously modifying the generated code, and jumping between code and canvas. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the in-builder code editor's capabilities (the linked edit-code article isn't in the pack), and independent or hands-on corroboration of editing code inside Make.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder

citations.quote: **Files**: Explore your app’s files and [edit its code]
